name: Public Works Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
summary: The department that builds and maintains Delhi's main roads, flyovers and underpasses.
ownership: Government of the National Capital Territory of Delhi
about: Delhi's roads are split between several bodies — the municipal corporation, the NDMC, the cantonment board and NHAI all own some — and Delhi PWD holds the biggest arterial roads, most flyovers and the underpasses. It is the department behind the ring roads and corridor upgrades, and the one to approach about the condition of a main Delhi road.
facts: Maintains most of Delhi's arterial roads, flyovers and underpasses.
Delhi's roads are divided between PWD, the municipal corporations, NDMC and NHAI.
Runs road complaint channels for the roads it owns.

grievance.note: Road condition complaints for PWD roads in Delhi go through the department's portal.
